text: Teaching Objectives To help student obtain knowledge and ability of business management, economic management and enterprise management, and enable student to deal with all kinds of business management related work in all kinds of organizations. Main Courses Principles of Management, micro-economics, macro-economics, Management Information System, Statistics, Marketing, Economic Law, Human Resource Management, Enterprise Strategic Management, Finance Management Internship Human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise. Degree Awarded Master of Business Administration Career Graduates can engage in the field of human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise.
